name: @maronn-openid-connect/sample-hono-cloudflare
description: Hono Cloudflare Workers sample backed by D1

scripts.generate: maronn-oidc generate hono --enable par --enable token-exchange --enable transaction-binding --enable jarm --enable device-authorization-grant --enable id-jag --enable ciba --output ./src/oidc-provider
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @maronn-openid-connect/core --filter @maronn-openid-connect/experimental run build && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.launch: pnpm --filter @maronn-openid-connect/core --filter @maronn-openid-connect/experimental run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @maronn-openid-connect/core --filter @maronn-openid-connect/experimental run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:conformance
